_README: System command aliases — applied before prefix expansion in dispatch. These ship with ARC and are editable by operators. User-defined aliases live in config/<user>/preferences.json (managed via the 'alias' builtin). Keys are what the user types (case-insensitive, exact match); values are the canonical command line dispatched instead.
_example_1: "sp": "show security policy"  — type 'sp' to run 'show security policy'
_example_2: "sif": "show interface all"    — type 'sif' to run 'show interface all'
